task: Add SQL exclusion predicate to rollups.py kind-4 INSERT filtering built-in CLI lifecycle command names, backed by a new vocabulary constant in vocabulary.py.

key_reasoning.reason: Two closely-related components: vocabulary.py (new built-in command name constant) and rollups.py (SQL predicate consuming that constant). Both live in the same cli_analytics/postgres package. Test files test_rollups.py and test_reader.py are also in scope for covering the identified gap, but no cross-layer orchestration is needed.

Task is specific and unambiguous: add a NOT IN exclusion for named built-in command names (model, exit, quit, clear, resume, compact) to the kind-4 rollup INSERT. One minor open question — whether session_dims.commands (summary path) also sends built-in names — is flagged as low-probability and unverifiable from server code alone, but does not block the primary fix.

Exact pattern already exists: SENTINEL_EXACT + _text_array in rollups.py is the precedent for building a SQL exclusion array from a vocabulary tuple. The vocabulary alignment risk (no leading slash per convention 9, unlike SENTINEL_EXACT which has leading slashes) is documented and straightforward to follow. Trivially reversible.

Four files modified: vocabulary.py (new constant), rollups.py (SQL predicate addition), test_rollups.py (assert exclusion predicate present), test_reader.py (assert via _invocation_branches that kind-4 OTel branch excludes built-ins). All in one package directory. No new files created.
